<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/one_time_charges"}
#docs
Every `one_time` line on the subscription's newest 100 invoices, excluding pending and voided invoices (never charged). `has_more` is true when older invoices were not read. `amount_minor` is integer minor units, before discounts.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | The subscription's id (sub_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The charge lines. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The invoice line id. |
| `data.description` | `string` | The line description. |
| `data.amount_minor` | `integer` | The line amount in minor units. |
| `data.invoice` | `string` | The invoice that holds the line. |
| `data.invoice_number` | `string` | The invoice number. |
| `data.invoice_status` | `string` | The invoice status. |
| `data.invoice_created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the invoice was created. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | True if older invoices exist beyond the 100 that the read covers. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A list of one-time charge lines |
| `404` | No such subscription |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/one_time_charges" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
